comment: Diary-retrieval probe fixture: first-person 1-2 sentence diary entries (the shape defaultDiaryPrompt produces) plus player actions labeled with which entries a character should recall. Positives are meaning-matches sharing no distinctive noun with the action (asserted); negatives are actions that should recall nothing. Sweeps DIARY_SIM_THRESHOLD (src/lib/semanticDiary.ts).

entries.text: The trader drew steel on me over a miscount today. I will not forget how fast that hand moved.
I lent them my last three coppers for the toll. Kindness, or foolishness - the road will tell.
They told the gate guard they were a courier. I held my tongue, but I know a false name when I hear one.
They gave me their own dry cloak in the storm without being asked. I slept warm and thought about that.
We shared a jar of plum wine by the fire and they laughed at my worst story. A good evening.
I bound the gash on their arm with my spare linen. They did not wince once, which worried me more than the cut.
Their gray mule bit me when I reached for its halter. The red ribbon does not make it friendly.
They hummed a tune from my home marshes tonight. I did not ask where they learned it, but it followed me into sleep.

actions.name: weapon-again
actions.text: I rest my palm on my knife hilt as the argument grows sharp.

actions.name: repay
actions.text: I count out what I owe and set it in front of her.

actions.name: false-name
actions.text: I introduce myself to the innkeeper as someone I am not.

actions.name: cold-night
actions.text: I offer to take the coldest watch so the others can sleep by the embers.

actions.name: injury
actions.text: I roll up my sleeve and show her the half-healed scar.

actions.name: neg-directions
actions.text: I ask the fisherman which fork leads to the hill fort.

actions.name: neg-shopping
actions.text: I haggle over the price of a sack of salt.

actions.name: neg-weather
actions.text: I study the clouds massing over the marsh.
